result.finding: Multi-module Layered MVC application with Event-Driven inter-module communication. The project consists of two independently deployable Spring Boot modules sharing a PostgreSQL database and communicating asynchronously via RabbitMQ. Each module follows a classic layered architecture (Controller → Service → Repository). This is NOT a full microservices architecture due to the shared database and absence of service discovery or API gateway.
evidence: Two separate Spring Boot @SpringBootApplication classes: AssetsManagerApplication (web) and WorkerApplication (worker)
Layered package structure in web module: controller/, service/, repository/, model/, config/
Layered package structure in worker module: service/, repository/, model/, config/
Spring MVC @Controller with Thymeleaf templates — MVC pattern in web module
@RabbitListener in web/BackupMessageProcessor.java and worker/AbstractFileProcessingService.java — Event-Driven inter-module communication
Shared PostgreSQL database between web and worker — not true microservices isolation
No service discovery (Eureka, Consul), no API gateway (Zuul, Spring Cloud Gateway) found
No docker-compose.yml with multiple services; no Kubernetes manifests
values: Event-Driven inter-module communication via RabbitMQ AMQP
Shared database pattern (not full microservices isolation)
